thread:
amber: Hey team, incoming customer escalation from Maria — multiple 502s and high tail latency hitting their hosted inference in eu-west2 since ~08:12 UTC. They're seeing timeouts and model failures. sample request id: req_0a3f9c. Can SRE / network look?

maria: Confirmed from their side — spike in 5xxs around 08:10, some requests taking >10s then failing. Customer report attached: logs + curl. They need ETA.

sre-bot: Automated alert: Increased 5xx rate for route /v1/generate in region eu-west2 at 2024-10-12T08:11:30Z. 5xx spike: +420% over baseline. Packet loss observed on egress path (p99 loss 1.8%).

jay: I'm oncall — looking now. Which AZs affected?

metric-bot: traceroute-sample to eu-west2-azb shows intermittent packet loss at hop 6 (provider-as64512).

raj: FYI we have a recent peering change with ISP-x in eu-west, rolling out yesterday. Checking BGP session health.

linda: Can you paste the customer's failing request (sanitized) and trace ids so we can repro?

amber: Customer provided curl, sanitized: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2.7B","input":"<payload>"}' \
  -v
```
Response body includes: `502 Bad Gateway` and `upstream timeout` in gateway logs.

raj: Running `bgp summary` on our eu peering edge — session to ISP-x shows flaps: 3 transitions in last 10m. Provider tickets open? I'm escalating to provider NOC.

jay: Can we fail traffic to other AZs or force fallback to eu-west2-azc? We should mitigate customer impact ASAP.

linda: We have cross-zone fallback policy but it's rate-limited for some tiers. For this customer (enterprise), we can temporarily override policy to allow cross-az routing. Prepping rollout.

maria: Please confirm before changing any routing — customer wants heads-up and we need to document.

raj: Provider confirmed BGP adj resets; they reported an internal maintenance window but (they) didn't notify us. Packet captures show packet drops and retransmits on egress.

jay: Action plan: 1) enable cross-az routing for customer route -> immediate mitigation 2) push traffic to eu-west2-azc host pool 3) monitor 5xx rate and tail latency 4) keep provider engager on the line.

linda: I'm toggling the override now. Command: `rbctl route override --customer=maria_co --region=eu-west2 --to-az=azc --force`

amber: Maria, we'll route your traffic to a different AZ while we work with the carrier. Expect brief connection resets during the shift (~1-2 minutes).

maria: ok please proceed, we need stability for live demo at 10:00 UTC.

metric-bot: Override applied by linda at 2024-10-12T08:24:12Z. Start monitoring.

raj: After reroute, p99 latency dropped from 2.8s to 0.48s for sampled requests. 5xx rate down to baseline in last 3m. Provider still shows BGP flaps but impact reduced due to new path.

jay: Good. Keep provider ticket open and get root cause. Also add traffic drift policy to avoid cold-start spike.

linda: Will add a temporary cache warmup: `rbctl cache prewarm --model=gpt-open-2.7B --az=azc --samples=50`

amber: Customer acked mitigation. They're asking for RCA and any SLA credits. Please capture timeline and logs.

raj: Capturing packet captures, BGP logs, and our route changes. Provider NOC assigned ticket #ISPX-9987. They indicate a flapped interface causing asymmetric egress we saw in pcap.

maria: Thank you — please send an incident timeline + postmortem when ready. We also need a note for their security team re: no data exfil.

jay: Noted. I'll start an incident doc and assign postmortem. Early severity: SEV2 (customer impact, mitigated).

metric-bot: 5xx rate back to normal across eu-west2. Continuing to monitor for 30m.

amber: Thanks everyone. If provider confirms fix, we'll revert override and schedule controlled rollback.

raj: Provider now reports interface replaced and BGP stable for 12m. I'll keep monitoring BGP session.

linda: Preparing rollback window in 15m to move traffic back. Will throttle to avoid spike.

jay: Great. After rollback, run synthetic checks and share perf graphs in this thread.

amber: Customer happy for now. Closing customer bridge; postmortem to follow.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-20241012-1746789012. Assigned: jay, raj, linda, amber.
